verdict.rationale: PII filtering is a fair question for a web-scraping platform, but the evidence pack never documents automatic PII detection or redaction before storage. The closest item is generic data-quality validation and alerting (apify-docs-7), which is a different feature and earns no credit. Custom Actor code is only a developer building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically detect and filter personally identifiable information out of scraped content before it reaches storage
